items.title: Keter Betts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996
items.q: Well you notice with Art Blakey’s group that anybody was leaving, he’d tell them, “you get me somebody that’s like you.”

ctx.x: I think it’s really fascinating how musicians recommend each other and they move around from group to group.
